items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did his brother Joe Rene ever play with you too? [INTERVIEWEE] No I didn't want to think I would play with you.

ctx.x: This fellow here, they buried about almost a year ago, Arthur Ogans, he used to play drum. Oh yes. He was a drummer at the time. And I was on banjo, I think, on trombone. Did he have the trombone? Yeah I was trying to think really well. I can't go.
I know it's hard to remember all those names. I was pretty young man. Do you remember who else was with Kid Rene when you'd play with him sometime?
I'm trying to think now. I know one time I was playing with little Charlie, he was on drums. I was a wonderful drummer before he kind of moved in my mind.
